lines.text: I'm finally back on my feet.

data.define: Recovered and able to do normal things again.

example.text: I'm finally back on my feet.

misuse.text: Don't say 'back on my feet' about standing up.
misuse.why: It means healthy and active again.

data.l1: de nuevo en pie; recuperado; volver a estar activo
data.l1_hook: La semana pasada enfermo, ¡hoy estoy 'back on my feet'!

native.tip: “back on my feet” = de nuevo en pie; recuperado; volver a estar activo. Ejemplo: “I'm finally back on my feet.”
native.caption:
¿Qué significa “back on my feet”?
“back on my feet” = de nuevo en pie; recuperado; volver a estar activo.
Ejemplo: “I'm finally back on my feet.” (Finalmente estoy 'back on my feet'.)
